### Wake Up!
Author: Neil T. Anderson
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/dailyinchrist/daily-in-christ-5-or-30-544574.html
Passage: Deuteronomy 18:10-12
Points:
- God strictly instructed His people to avoid all occult practices, divination, and witchcraft.
- Modern society continues to see the active presence of dark and destructive spiritual practices.
- Seemingly mild occult interests share the same dark spiritual roots as extreme rituals.
- Christians must recognize the spiritual battle and rely on Jesus to reclaim lost ground.

### What’s Your Sign?
Author: Ryan Duncan
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/crosswalk-devo/what-s-your-sign-crosswalk-the-devotional-apr-18-2011.html
Passage: Deuteronomy 18:10-12
Points:
- Scripture condemns consulting omens, sorcery, and other forms of divination.
- Horoscopes and zodiac readings function as subtle forms of idolatry.
- Looking to constellations for guidance signals a lack of trust in God's sovereignty.
- Believers should look to the cross of Christ rather than the stars for guidance.
